name: hawahisaab
description: HawaHisaab — Urban Air Quality Assistant for families

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=engine && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,server,web -c cyan,green,blue "npm run dev --workspace=engine" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
